        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  if (\n    request.nextUrl.pathname !== \"/\" &amp;&amp;\n    !user &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/login\") &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\")\n  ) {\n    // no user, potentially respond by redirecting the user to the login page\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n}",

        "contents": "3. **Domain Validation**:\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Database constraint ensures only valid domains in approved_emails\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Identity Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify and link\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Link the email identity to current Google user\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n  provider: 'email'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nCheck JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |\n\n| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |\n\n| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security\n5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",

          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: OTP Verification and Identity Linking",

          },

            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "// After user enters OTP, verify and link",

          },
          {
            "text": "const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({",

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: Middleware Validation",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "Check JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "## Estimated Complexity",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "text": "| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "## Simplicity Principles",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)",
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions",
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security",
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",
            "lineNumber": 421
          }
        ]

        "contents": "create table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Work email linked?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J[Link work email identity]\n        J --&gt; K{Email in approved list?}\n        D --&gt;|Yes| K\n        K --&gt;|No| L[Pending Approval Page]\n        K --&gt;|Yes| M[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        N[Incoming Request] --&gt; O[Middleware checks JWT]\n        O --&gt; P{Has verified_work_email?}\n        P --&gt;|No| Q[Redirect to verify email]\n        P --&gt;|Yes| R{is_approved claim?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Show pending approval]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Approval Check)**: Check if specific email is in &#96;approved_emails&#96; table\n\n   - Embedded in JWT via custom claims hook\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;approved_emails&#96;** - Pre-approved specific email addresses (admin-managed)\n2. **&#96;user_profiles&#96;** - User data with role and verified work email\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Key tables structure\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\n  from public.user_profiles\n  where id = (event-&gt;&gt;'user_id')::uuid;\n\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\n  select exists(\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\n  ) into is_approved;\n\n  -- Build custom claims\n  claims := coalesce(event-&gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\n\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Testing custom claims hook**: Execute and iterate on the Postgres function directly\n2. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n3. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n4. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and JWT claims\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Run SQL queries to test the custom_access_token hook function\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into approved_emails table\n- Inspect auth.users and user_profiles tables\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; | Replaced by Google login button |\n\n| &#96;components/sign-up-form.tsx&#96; | No separate signup - just Google OAuth |\n\n| &#96;components/forgot-password-form.tsx&#96; | No passwords to forget |\n\n| &#96;components/update-password-form.tsx&#96; | No passwords to update |",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function SignUpForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState(\"\");\n  const [repeatPassword, setRepeatPassword] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleSignUp = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    if (password !== repeatPassword) {\n      setError(\"Passwords do not match\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n        email,\n        password,\n        options: {\n          emailRedirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/protected&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      router.push(\"/auth/sign-up-success\");\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\n\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\n\n| Access without approval                     | Middleware checks &#96;is_approved&#96; JWT claim           |\n\n### Optional: &#96;before_user_created&#96; Hook (Extra Layer)\n\nPostgres hook to reject any user not created via Google:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.reject_non_google_signup(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nas $$\nbegin\n  -- Only allow users created via Google OAuth\n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata'-&gt;&gt;'provider' != 'google' then\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'decision', 'reject',\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\n    );\n  end if;\n  return event;\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/reject_non_google_signup\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom Access Token Hook\n\nPostgres function to embed claims in JWT:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nas $$\ndeclare\n  claims jsonb;\n  user_role text;\n  work_email text;\n  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data",

        "contents": "### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)\n- Define schemas with proper relationships and constraints\n- Infer types from schema definitions\n- Write repository-style helpers to isolate queries\n- Implement proper migrations\n\n### Data Access Patterns\n\n- Keep database queries in dedicated modules\n- Avoid N+1 queries; use joins and CTEs\n- Implement pagination for list endpoints\n- Use select projections to limit payload size\n\n## Authentication &amp; Authorization\n\n- Implement server-side auth checks\n- Never trust client-side auth flags\n- Use middleware for route protection\n- Store user data securely with proper encryption\n\n## Testing Strategy\n\n### Unit Testing (Vitest)\n\n- **Never mock internal code** - only mock external dependencies\n- Use MSW for API mocking when needed\n- Test utilities, repositories, and business logic\n- Mock external services (APIs, databases, file systems)\n\n### Component Testing (React Testing Library)\n\n- Test interactive components with proper accessibility\n- Ensure loading and error states are covered\n- Test user interactions and state changes\n- Use data-testid sparingly; prefer semantic queries\n\n### Integration Testing\n\n- Test API endpoints with real database connections\n- Use test databases with proper cleanup\n- Test authentication flows end-to-end\n- Mock external services consistently\n\n### Test Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Example test structure\ndescribe(\"Feature\", () =&gt; {\n  describe(\"when condition\", () =&gt; {\n    it(\"should expected behavior\", async () =&gt; {\n      // Arrange\n      // Act\n      // Assert\n    });\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Error Handling &amp; Observability\n\n- Implement early returns on invalid input (fail fast)\n- Use typed error codes and messages\n- Log server-side with contextual metadata\n- Never expose stack traces to clients\n- Provide user-friendly error messages\n\n## Security Best Practices\n\n- Validate all inputs at boundaries\n- Use environment variables for sensitive data (server-only)\n- Implement proper CORS policies\n- Sanitize user inputs\n- Use HTTPS in production\n- Implement rate limiting where appropriate",

        "contents": "3. **Domain Validation**:\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Database constraint ensures only valid domains in approved_emails\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Identity Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify and link\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Link the email identity to current Google user\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n  provider: 'email'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nCheck JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |\n\n| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |\n\n| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security\n5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/auth/callback/route.ts",
        "range": {

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\n\n/**\n * OAuth callback handler\n * Processes Google OAuth callback and redirects to appropriate page based on user state\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has verified work email\n      const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n      const claims = data?.claims;\n\n      if (!claims?.verified_work_email) {\n        // Redirect to work email verification\n        redirect(\"/auth/verify-work-email\");\n      } else if (!claims?.is_approved) {\n        // Redirect to pending approval page\n        redirect(\"/auth/pending-approval\");\n      } else {\n        // User is fully authenticated and approved\n        redirect(next);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // If there's an error or no code, redirect to error page\n  redirect(\"/auth/error?error=Authentication failed\");\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Work email linked?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J[Link work email identity]\n        J --&gt; K{Email in approved list?}\n        D --&gt;|Yes| K\n        K --&gt;|No| L[Pending Approval Page]\n        K --&gt;|Yes| M[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        N[Incoming Request] --&gt; O[Middleware checks JWT]\n        O --&gt; P{Has verified_work_email?}\n        P --&gt;|No| Q[Redirect to verify email]\n        P --&gt;|Yes| R{is_approved claim?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Show pending approval]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Approval Check)**: Check if specific email is in &#96;approved_emails&#96; table\n\n   - Embedded in JWT via custom claims hook\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;approved_emails&#96;** - Pre-approved specific email addresses (admin-managed)\n2. **&#96;user_profiles&#96;** - User data with role and verified work email\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Key tables structure\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",

        "detailedLines": [

          },
          {
            "text": "        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J[Link work email identity]",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt; K{Email in approved list?}",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| K",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        K --&gt;|No| L[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        K --&gt;|Yes| M[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "        N[Incoming Request] --&gt; O[Middleware checks JWT]",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "        O --&gt; P{Has verified_work_email?}",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P --&gt;|No| Q[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        P --&gt;|Yes| R{is_approved claim?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Show pending approval]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T[Allow access]",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Approval Check)**: Check if specific email is in &#96;approved_emails&#96; table",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Embedded in JWT via custom claims hook",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;approved_emails&#96;** - Pre-approved specific email addresses (admin-managed)",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;user_profiles&#96;** - User data with role and verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Key tables structure",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "create table public.approved_emails (",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "  email text unique not null,",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now(),",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "  constraint valid_czu_domain check (",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "  )",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "create table public.user_profiles (",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",
            "lineNumber": 103
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\n\n/**\n * Work email verification form component\n * Handles work email input, OTP sending, OTP verification, and identity linking\n */\nexport function WorkEmailForm() {\n  const [workEmail, setWorkEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleSendOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    // Validate domain\n    if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n      setError(\"Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const supabase = createClient();\n      \n      // Send OTP to work email (without creating a new user)\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n        email: workEmail,\n        options: {\n          shouldCreateUser: false,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to send OTP\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "create table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // If no user and not on public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user exists, check work email verification and approval\n  if (user) {\n    const verifiedWorkEmail = user.verified_work_email as string | undefined;\n    const isApproved = user.is_approved as boolean | undefined;\n\n    // Protected routes require verified work email\n    if (!isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAuthRoute &amp;&amp; !verifiedWorkEmail) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Protected routes require approval (except verify-work-email page)\n    if (\n      !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp;\n      !isAuthRoute &amp;&amp;\n      pathname !== \"/auth/verify-work-email\" &amp;&amp;\n      !isApproved\n    ) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Admin routes require admin role\n    if (isAdminRoute &amp;&amp; user.role !== \"admin\") {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;app/admin/users/page.tsx&#96; - Approved emails table (admin only)",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "### Components (2 files)",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;components/google-login-button.tsx&#96; - Single OAuth button",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;components/work-email-form.tsx&#96; - Email input + OTP verification",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "## Key Security Features (Handled by Supabase)",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **RLS Policies**:",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Users can only read/update their own profile",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Only admins can manage approved emails",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Approved emails table viewable only by admins",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Custom JWT Claims Hook**:",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Runs on every token refresh",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Embeds role, verified_work_email, and is_approved directly in JWT",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "   - No additional DB queries needed for authorization checks",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Domain Validation**:",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)",
            "lineNumber": 344
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = [\"/\", \"/auth/login\", \"/auth/error\", \"/auth/callback\"];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.some((route) =&gt; pathname === route || pathname.startsWith(route));\n\n  // Auth routes that require authentication but may not require full approval\n  const authRoutes = [\"/auth/verify-work-email\", \"/auth/pending-approval\"];\n  const isAuthRoute = authRoutes.some((route) =&gt; pathname.startsWith(route));\n\n  // Admin routes\n  const isAdminRoute = pathname.startsWith(\"/admin\");\n\n  // If no user and not on public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\n  from public.user_profiles\n  where id = (event-&gt;&gt;'user_id')::uuid;\n\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\n  select exists(\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\n  ) into is_approved;\n\n  -- Build custom claims\n  claims := coalesce(event-&gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\n\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Testing custom claims hook**: Execute and iterate on the Postgres function directly\n2. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n3. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n4. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and JWT claims\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Run SQL queries to test the custom_access_token hook function\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into approved_emails table\n- Inspect auth.users and user_profiles tables\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; | Replaced by Google login button |\n\n| &#96;components/sign-up-form.tsx&#96; | No separate signup - just Google OAuth |\n\n| &#96;components/forgot-password-form.tsx&#96; | No passwords to forget |\n\n| &#96;components/update-password-form.tsx&#96; | No passwords to update |",

        "contents": "# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nauth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"\n\n# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n[auth.mfa]\n# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.\nmax_enrolled_factors = 10\n\n# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)\n[auth.mfa.totp]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\n\n# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging\n[auth.mfa.phone]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\notp_length = 6\ntemplate = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Configure MFA via WebAuthn\n# [auth.mfa.web_authn]\n# enroll_enabled = true\n# verify_enabled = true\n\n# Use an external OAuth provider. The full list of providers are: &#96;apple&#96;, &#96;azure&#96;, &#96;bitbucket&#96;,\n# &#96;discord&#96;, &#96;facebook&#96;, &#96;github&#96;, &#96;gitlab&#96;, &#96;google&#96;, &#96;keycloak&#96;, &#96;linkedin_oidc&#96;, &#96;notion&#96;, &#96;twitch&#96;,\n# &#96;twitter&#96;, &#96;x&#96;, &#96;slack&#96;, &#96;spotify&#96;, &#96;workos&#96;, &#96;zoom&#96;.\n[auth.external.apple]\nenabled = false\nclient_id = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your OAuth provider secret to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nsecret = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_APPLE_SECRET)\"\n# Overrides the default auth redirectUrl.\nredirect_uri = \"\"\n# Overrides the default auth provider URL. Used to support self-hosted gitlab, single-tenant Azure,\n# or any other third-party OIDC providers.\nurl = \"\"\n# If enabled, the nonce check will be skipped. Required for local sign in with Google auth.\nskip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/config.toml",

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 376

        "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\nredirect_uri = \"\"\nurl = \"\"\nskip_nonce_check = false\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]",

## Summary

Work email authentication system implemented. Completed:

### Completed tasks

1. Cleanup — Deleted 8 password-based auth files:
   - `components/login-form.tsx`
   - `components/sign-up-form.tsx`
   - `components/forgot-password-form.tsx`
   - `components/update-password-form.tsx`
   - `app/auth/sign-up/page.tsx`
   - `app/auth/sign-up-success/page.tsx`
   - `app/auth/forgot-password/page.tsx`
   - `app/auth/update-password/page.tsx`

2. Security lockdown — Updated `supabase/config.toml`:
   - Enabled `enable_manual_linking = true`
   - Disabled email signup (`enable_signup = false` in `[auth.email]`)
   - Configured Google OAuth provider
   - Enabled custom access token hook

3. Database schema — Created migrations:
   - `20260130000001_auth_tables.sql` — Creates `approved_emails` and `user_profiles` tables with RLS policies
   - `20260130000002_custom_claims_hook.sql` — Creates custom JWT claims hook function

4. Constants — Created `lib/constants/auth.ts` with domain validation

5. Middleware — Updated `lib/supabase/proxy.ts` to check:
   - `verified_work_email` claim
   - `is_approved` claim
   - Admin role for admin routes

6. Google login — Created:
   - `components/google-login-button.tsx` — Google OAuth button
   - `app/auth/login/page.tsx` — Rewritten login page
   - `app/auth/callback/route.ts` — OAuth callback handler

7. Work email verification — Created:
   - `components/work-email-form.tsx` — Email input + OTP verification form
   - `app/auth/verify-work-email/page.tsx` — Verification page

8. Pending approval — Created `app/auth/pending-approval/page.tsx`

9. Admin UI — Created:
   - `app/admin/users/page.tsx` — Admin page
   - `components/admin/approved-emails-table.tsx` — Email management component

10. Auth button — Updated `components/auth-button.tsx` to show verified work email and admin status

### Next steps

1. Run migrations: Apply the database migrations using Supabase CLI or MCP
2. Set environment variables: Configure `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` in your Supabase config
3. Test the flow:
   - Google OAuth login
   - Work email verification
   - Admin approval workflow
4. Create first admin: Manually set a user's role to 'admin' in the database to access the admin UI

The system is ready for testing. All components follow the plan's architecture and security requirements.

<tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="mcp-supabase-user-supabase-execute_sql">

      "name": "execute_sql",
      "parameters": "{\"query\":\"-- Update the function to check identities array instead of app_metadata\\ncreate or replace function public.reject_non_google_signup(event jsonb)\\nreturns jsonb\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  provider_name text;\\nbegin\\n  -- Check if user has identities array and if any identity is from Google\\n  -- For Google OAuth, the provider will be in the identities array\\n  select provider into provider_name\\n  from jsonb_array_elements(event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities') as identity\\n  limit 1;\\n  \\n  -- If no provider found or provider is not 'google', reject\\n  if provider_name is null or provider_name != 'google' then\\n    return jsonb_build_object(\\n      'decision', 'reject',\\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\\n    );\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- Allow the user creation to proceed\\n  return event;\\nend;\\n$$;\"}",

<tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="mcp-supabase-user-supabase-execute_sql">
<details>
<summary>Tool use: **mcp-supabase-user-supabase-execute_sql**</summary>

  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "execute_sql",
      "parameters": "{\"query\":\"-- Make the function more robust to handle edge cases\\ncreate or replace function public.reject_non_google_signup(event jsonb)\\nreturns jsonb\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  provider_name text;\\n  identities jsonb;\\nbegin\\n  -- Get the identities array from the user object\\n  identities := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities';\\n  \\n  -- If identities is null or empty array, reject (shouldn't happen for OAuth)\\n  if identities is null or jsonb_array_length(identities) = 0 then\\n    return jsonb_build_object(\\n      'decision', 'reject',\\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\\n    );\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- Check if any identity has provider 'google'\\n  select (identity-&gt;&gt;'provider')::text into provider_name\\n  from jsonb_array_elements(identities) as identity\\n  where (identity-&gt;&gt;'provider')::text = 'google'\\n  limit 1;\\n  \\n  -- If no Google provider found, reject\\n  if provider_name is null or provider_name != 'google' then\\n    return jsonb_build_object(\\n      'decision', 'reject',\\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\\n    );\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- Allow the user creation to proceed\\n  return event;\\nend;\\n$$;\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}

Fixed the `reject_non_google_signup` hook error. Summary:

1. Created the missing function — Added a migration that creates the `reject_non_google_signup` function
2. Updated the function — Checks the `identities` array (where Google OAuth stores provider info) instead of `app_metadata`
3. Enabled the hook in config — Uncommented and configured the `before_user_created` hook in `supabase/config.toml`

The function now:
- Checks for the `identities` array in the user event
- Validates that at least one identity exists
- Verifies that at least one identity has provider `'google'`
- Rejects signups that don't come from Google OAuth

Try signing in with Google again. The hook should allow Google OAuth signups and reject other authentication methods.

**Note**: If you're running Supabase locally, restart the Supabase instance for the config changes to take effect:
```bash
supabase stop
supabase start
```

Fixed the security issue by adding `set search_path = public` to all security definer functions. This prevents search_path attacks.

**Fixed functions:**
1. `reject_non_google_signup` - Added `set search_path = public`
2. `custom_access_token_hook` - Added `set search_path = public`
3. `handle_new_user` - Added `set search_path = public`
4. `update_updated_at_column` - Added `set search_path = public` (even though it's not security definer, it's good practice)

All migrations have been updated and applied to the database. The security advisor should no longer flag these functions. The `set search_path = public` clause ensures these functions always use a fixed search path, preventing attackers from manipulating the schema search order to execute malicious code.

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n  const isAuthRoute = authRoutes.some((route) =&gt; pathname.startsWith(route));\n\n  // Admin routes\n  const isAdminRoute = pathname.startsWith(\"/admin\");\n\n  // If no user and not on public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user exists, check work email verification and approval\n  if (user) {\n    const verifiedWorkEmail = user.verified_work_email as string | undefined;\n    const isApproved = user.is_approved as boolean | undefined;\n\n    // Protected routes require verified work email\n    if (!isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAuthRoute &amp;&amp; !verifiedWorkEmail) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Protected routes require approval (except verify-work-email page)\n    if (\n      !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp;\n      !isAuthRoute &amp;&amp;\n      pathname !== \"/auth/verify-work-email\" &amp;&amp;\n      !isApproved\n    ) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Admin routes require admin role\n    if (isAdminRoute &amp;&amp; user.role !== \"admin\") {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "export function WorkEmailForm() {\n\n\n  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const supabase = createClient();\n\n      // Get current user\n      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      if (!user) {\n        throw new Error(\"No authenticated user\");\n      }\n\n      // Verify OTP - this will create/link the email identity\n      // With manual_linking enabled, Supabase will link the email to the current Google user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: workEmail,\n        token: otpCode,\n        type: \"email\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) throw verifyError;\n\n      // Update user profile with verified work email\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase\n        .from(\"user_profiles\")\n        .update({ verified_work_email: workEmail.toLowerCase() })\n        .eq(\"id\", user.id);\n\n      if (profileError) throw profileError;\n\n      // Refresh session to get updated claims\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Check if user is approved\n      const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n      const claims = data?.claims;\n\n      if (!claims?.is_approved) {\n        router.push(\"/auth/pending-approval\");\n      } else {\n        router.push(\"/protected\");\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to verify OTP\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (step === \"otp\") {\n    return (\n      &lt;form onSubmit={handleVerifyOtp}\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles Google authentication flow and redirects to work email verification if needed\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const supabase = createClient();\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) throw error;\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to sign in with Google\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;Button\n        onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n        disabled={isLoading}\n        className=\"w-full\"\n        size=\"lg\"\n      &gt;\n        {isLoading ? \"Signing in...\" : \"Sign in with Google\"}\n      &lt;/Button&gt;\n      {error &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-destructive text-center\"&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\n\n/**\n * Work email verification form component\n * Handles work email input, OTP sending, OTP verification, and identity linking\n */\nexport function WorkEmailForm() {\n  const [workEmail, setWorkEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleSendOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    // Validate domain\n    if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n      setError(\"Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const supabase = createClient();\n      \n      // Send OTP to work email (without creating a new user)\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n        email: workEmail,\n        options: {\n          shouldCreateUser: false,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Failed to send OTP\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Custom access token hook to embed claims in JWT\n-- This function runs on every token refresh and adds custom claims\ncreate or replace function public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public\nas $$\ndeclare\n  claims jsonb;\n  user_role text;\n  work_email text;\n  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\n  from public.user_profiles\n  where id = (event-&gt;&gt;'user_id')::uuid;\n\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\n  select exists(\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\n  ) into is_approved;\n\n  -- Build custom claims\n  claims := coalesce(event-&gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\n\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\nend;\n$$;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "3. **Domain Validation**:\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Database constraint ensures only valid domains in approved_emails\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Identity Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify and link\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Link the email identity to current Google user\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n  provider: 'email'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nCheck JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |\n\n| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |\n\n| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security\n5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

            "text": "const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "  provider: 'email'",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "});",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: Middleware Validation",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "Check JWT claims for &#96;verified_work_email&#96; and &#96;is_approved&#96; on every request to protected routes.",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "## Estimated Complexity",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL |",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "| JWT claims hook | Low | ~30 lines SQL |",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~15 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "| Middleware update | Low | ~20 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "text": "| Work email form | Medium | ~100 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "| Admin UI | Low | ~80 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "**Total new code**: ~325 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "## Simplicity Principles",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **No separate services** - Business logic in Supabase (RLS + hooks)",
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions",
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Database-first validation** - Constraints + RLS handle security",
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **JWT claims for authorization** - No per-request DB lookups",
            "lineNumber": 421
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2395915985107422

        "contents": "  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\n  from public.user_profiles\n  where id = (event-&gt;&gt;'user_id')::uuid;\n\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\n  select exists(\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\n  ) into is_approved;\n\n  -- Build custom claims\n  claims := coalesce(event-&gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_approved}', to_jsonb(coalesce(is_approved, false)));\n\n  return jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.custom_access_token]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Testing custom claims hook**: Execute and iterate on the Postgres function directly\n2. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n3. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n4. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and JWT claims\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Run SQL queries to test the custom_access_token hook function\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into approved_emails table\n- Inspect auth.users and user_profiles tables\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; | Replaced by Google login button |\n\n| &#96;components/sign-up-form.tsx&#96; | No separate signup - just Google OAuth |\n\n| &#96;components/forgot-password-form.tsx&#96; | No passwords to forget |\n\n| &#96;components/update-password-form.tsx&#96;         "contents": "create table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",
