        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Work email linked?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J[Link work email identity]\n        J --&gt; K{Email in approved list?}\n        D --&gt;|Yes| K\n        K --&gt;|No| L[Pending Approval Page]\n        K --&gt;|Yes| M[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        N[Incoming Request] --&gt; O[Middleware checks JWT]\n        O --&gt; P{Has verified_work_email?}\n        P --&gt;|No| Q[Redirect to verify email]\n        P --&gt;|Yes| R{is_approved claim?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Show pending approval]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Approval Check)**: Check if specific email is in &#96;approved_emails&#96; table\n\n   - Embedded in JWT via custom claims hook\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;approved_emails&#96;** - Pre-approved specific email addresses (admin-managed)\n2. **&#96;user_profiles&#96;** - User data with role and verified work email\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Key tables structure\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",

        "contents": "-- Create approved_emails table for pre-approved work email addresses\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Create user_profiles table for user data with role and verified work email\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n\n-- Enable RLS\nalter table public.approved_emails enable row level security;\nalter table public.user_profiles enable row level security;\n\n-- RLS Policies for approved_emails\n-- Only admins can view all approved emails\ncreate policy \"Admins can view all approved emails\"\n  on public.approved_emails\n  for select\n  using (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- Only admins can insert approved emails\ncreate policy \"Admins can insert approved emails\"\n  on public.approved_emails\n  for insert\n  with check (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- Only admins can delete approved emails\ncreate policy \"Admins can delete approved emails\"\n  on public.approved_emails\n  for delete\n  using (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- RLS Policies for user_profiles\n-- Users can view their own profile\ncreate policy \"Users can view own profile\"\n  on public.user_profiles\n  for select\n  using (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- Users can update their own profile (but not role)\ncreate policy \"Users can update own profile\"\n  on public.user_profiles",

## Debugging steps

### 1. Check server console logs
The callback route logs errors. Look for:
- `"Auth callback error:"` — errors from Supabase
- `"Unexpected error in auth callback:"` — other errors

### 2. Check the error page
The error page now shows the actual error message. After a failed login, check what it displays.

### 3. Verify redirect URLs
Updated `supabase/config.toml` to include the callback URL. If running Supabase locally, restart it:
```bash
supabase stop
supabase start
```

### 4. Check the `reject_non_google_signup` hook
The hook might be rejecting signups. To test, temporarily disable it:
1. Comment out the hook in `supabase/config.toml`:
```toml
# [auth.hook.before_user_created]
# enabled = true
# uri = "pg-functions://postgres/public/reject_non_google_signup"
```
2. Restart Supabase
3. Try logging in again

### 5. Verify Google OAuth configuration
Ensure:
- `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` are set in your environment
- The Google OAuth app redirect URI matches: `http://127.0.0.1:54321/auth/v1/callback` (for local Supabase)

### 6. Check browser network tab
In DevTools → Network, inspect the `/auth/callback` request to see:
- The response status
- Any error messages in the response

Try logging in again and check the server console and error page for the specific error message.

        "contents": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;verified_work_email&#96; JWT claim   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\n\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\n\n| Access without approval                     | Middleware checks &#96;is_approved&#96; JWT claim           |\n\n### Optional: &#96;before_user_created&#96; Hook (Extra Layer)\n\nPostgres hook to reject any user not created via Google:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.reject_non_google_signup(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nas $$\nbegin\n  -- Only allow users created via Google OAuth\n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata'-&gt;&gt;'provider' != 'google' then\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'decision', 'reject',\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\n    );\n  end if;\n  return event;\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nEnable in config:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/reject_non_google_signup\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom Access Token Hook\n\nPostgres function to embed claims in JWT:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nas $$\ndeclare\n  claims jsonb;\n  user_role text;\n  work_email text;\n  is_approved boolean;\nbegin\n  -- Get user profile data",

        "contents": "-- Optional hook to reject non-Google signups at database level\n-- This provides an extra security layer beyond config settings\ncreate or replace function public.reject_non_google_signup(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public\nas $$\ndeclare\n  provider_name text;\n  identities jsonb;\nbegin\n  -- Get the identities array from the user object\n  identities := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities';\n  \n  -- If identities is null or empty array, reject (shouldn't happen for OAuth)\n  if identities is null or jsonb_array_length(identities) = 0 then\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'decision', 'reject',\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\n    );\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Check if any identity has provider 'google'\n  select (identity-&gt;&gt;'provider')::text into provider_name\n  from jsonb_array_elements(identities) as identity\n  where (identity-&gt;&gt;'provider')::text = 'google'\n  limit 1;\n  \n  -- If no Google provider found, reject\n  if provider_name is null or provider_name != 'google' then\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'decision', 'reject',\n      'message', 'Only Google login is allowed'\n    );\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Allow the user creation to proceed\n  return event;\nend;\n$$;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "double_confirm_changes = true\n# If enabled, users need to confirm their email address before signing in.\nenable_confirmations = false\n# If enabled, users will need to reauthenticate or have logged in recently to change their password.\nsecure_password_change = false\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another signup confirmation or password reset email.\nmax_frequency = \"1s\"\n# Number of characters used in the email OTP.\notp_length = 6\n# Number of seconds before the email OTP expires (defaults to 1 hour).\notp_expiry = 3600\n\n# Use a production-ready SMTP server\n# [auth.email.smtp]\n# enabled = true\n# host = \"smtp.sendgrid.net\"\n# port = 587\n# user = \"apikey\"\n# pass = \"env(SENDGRID_API_KEY)\"\n# admin_email = \"admin@email.com\"\n# sender_name = \"Admin\"\n\n# Uncomment to customize email template\n# [auth.email.template.invite]\n# subject = \"You have been invited\"\n# content_path = \"./supabase/templates/invite.html\"\n\n# Uncomment to customize notification email template\n# [auth.email.notification.password_changed]\n# enabled = true\n# subject = \"Your password has been         "contents": "---\nname: Work Email Auth System\noverview: Build a robust authentication system using Supabase with Google OAuth, manual identity linking for work email verification (@studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz), and role-based permissions with admin management UI.\ntodos:\n  - id: cleanup-old-auth\n    content: Delete unused password-based auth files (8 files)\n    status: pending\n  - id: security-lockdown\n    content: Lock down Supabase to only allow Google OAuth (disable email signup, other providers)\n    status: pending\n  - id: db-schema\n    content: Create Supabase migration for approved_emails and user_profiles tables with RLS\n    status: pending\n  - id: jwt-hook\n    content: Create and test custom_access_token hook using Supabase MCP\n    status: pending\n  - id: supabase-config\n    content: Update supabase/config.toml (manual_linking, Google OAuth, security settings)\n    status: pending\n  - id: auth-constants\n    content: Create lib/constants/auth.ts with domain validation\n    status: pending\n  - id: middleware-update\n    content: Update proxy.ts to check verified_work_email and is_approved JWT claims\n    status: pending\n  - id: google-login\n    content: Create Google login button and rewrite login page\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-email-flow\n    content: Create work email verification page with OTP and identity linking\n    status: pending\n  - id: admin-ui\n    content: Create simple admin page for managing approved emails\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# Work Email Authentication System\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        ",

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\n  \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"https://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/callback\",\n]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL.         "contents": "name: Deploy Supabase Resources\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches:\n      - preview\n      - production\n    paths:\n      - 'supabase/**'\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      environment:\n        description: 'Environment to deploy to'\n        required: true\n        type: choice\n        options:\n          - preview\n          - production\n\njobs:\n  deploy_staging:\n    environment: preview\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/preview' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n  deploy_production:\n    environment: production\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'production')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "create policy \"Users can update own profile\"\n  on public.user_profiles\n  for update\n  using (id = auth.uid())\n  with check (\n    id = auth.uid() and\n    -- Prevent users from changing their own role\n    (old.role = new.role or old.role is null)\n  );\n\n-- Allow system to insert user profiles (via trigger or admin)\ncreate policy \"Allow user profile creation\"\n  on public.user_profiles\n  for insert\n  with check (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- Admins can view all user profiles\ncreate policy \"Admins can view all profiles\"\n  on public.user_profiles\n  for select\n  using (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- Create function to automatically create user profile on user creation\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public\nas $$\nbegin\n  insert into public.user_profiles (id, google_email)\n  values (\n    new.id,\n    new.email\n  );\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\n-- Create trigger to call the function when a new user is created\ncreate trigger on_auth_user_created\n  after insert on auth.users\n  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Create function to update updated_at timestamp\ncreate or replace function public.update_updated_at_column()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nset search_path = public\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at = now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\n-- Create trigger to update updated_at on user_profiles\ncreate trigger update_user_profiles_updated_at\n  before update on public.user_profiles\n  for each row execute function public.update_updated_at_column();",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Work email linked?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J[Link work email identity]\n        J --&gt; K{Email in approved list?}\n        D --&gt;|Yes| K\n        K --&gt;|No| L[Pending Approval Page]\n        K --&gt;|Yes| M[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        N[Incoming Request] --&gt; O[Middleware checks JWT]\n        O --&gt; P{Has verified_work_email?}\n        P --&gt;|No| Q[Redirect to verify email]\n        P --&gt;|Yes| R{is_approved claim?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Show pending approval]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Approval Check)**: Check if specific email is in &#96;approved_emails&#96; table\n\n   - Embedded in JWT via custom claims hook\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;approved_emails&#96;** - Pre-approved specific email addresses (admin-managed)\n2. **&#96;user_profiles&#96;** - User data with role and verified work email\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Key tables structure\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\n\n/**\n * OAuth callback handler\n * Processes Google OAuth callback and redirects to appropriate page based on user state\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const errorParam = searchParams.get(\"error\");\n  const errorDescription = searchParams.get(\"error_description\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  // If there's an error parameter from OAuth provider, redirect to error page\n  if (errorParam) {\n    const errorMessage = errorDescription \n      ? &#96;${errorParam}: ${errorDescription}&#96; \n      : errorParam;\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(errorMessage)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  if (!code) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/error?error=No authorization code provided\");\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Auth callback error:\", error);\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message || \"Authentication failed\")}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!data?.session) {\n      redirect(\"/auth/error?error=No session created\");\n    }\n\n    // Check if user has verified work email\n    const { data: claimsData } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n}",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = [\"/\", \"/auth/login\", \"/auth/error\", \"/auth/callback\"];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.some((route) =&gt; pathname === route || pathname.startsWith(route));\n\n  // Auth routes that require authentication but may not require full approval\n  const authRoutes = [\"/auth/verify-work-email\", \"/auth/pending-approval\"];\n  const isAuthRoute = authRoutes.some((route) =&gt; pathname.startsWith(route));\n\n  // Admin routes\n  const isAdminRoute = pathname.startsWith(\"/admin\");\n}",

        "contents": "    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'production')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n  const isAuthRoute = authRoutes.some((route) =&gt; pathname.startsWith(route));\n\n  // Admin routes\n  const isAdminRoute = pathname.startsWith(\"/admin\");\n\n  // If no user and not on public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user exists, check work email verification and approval\n  if (user) {\n    const verifiedWorkEmail = user.verified_work_email as string | undefined;\n    const isApproved = user.is_approved as boolean | undefined;\n\n    // Protected routes require verified work email\n    if (!isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAuthRoute &amp;&amp; !verifiedWorkEmail) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Protected routes require approval (except verify-work-email page)\n    if (\n      !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp;\n      !isAuthRoute &amp;&amp;\n      pathname !== \"/auth/verify-work-email\" &amp;&amp;\n      !isApproved\n    ) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // Admin routes require admin role\n    if (isAdminRoute &amp;&amp; user.role !== \"admin\") {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Create approved_emails table for pre-approved work email addresses\ncreate table public.approved_emails (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  created_by uuid references auth.users(id),\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Create user_profiles table for user data with role and verified work email\ncreate table public.user_profiles (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\n  verified_work_email text unique,\n  google_email text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n\n-- Enable RLS\nalter table public.approved_emails enable row level security;\nalter table public.user_profiles enable row level security;\n\n-- RLS Policies for approved_emails\n-- Only admins can view all approved emails\ncreate policy \"Admins can view all approved emails\"\n  on public.approved_emails\n  for select\n  using (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- Only admins can insert approved emails\ncreate policy \"Admins can insert approved emails\"\n  on public.approved_emails\n  for insert\n  with check (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- Only admins can delete approved emails\ncreate policy \"Admins can delete approved emails\"\n  on public.approved_emails\n  for delete\n  using (\n    exists (\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\n    )\n  );\n\n-- RLS Policies for user_profiles\n-- Users can view their own profile\ncreate policy \"Users can view own profile\"\n  on public.user_profiles\n  for select\n  using (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- Users can update their own profile (but not role)\ncreate policy \"Users can update own profile\"\n  on public.user_profiles",

Updated the `custom_access_token_hook` to handle edge cases. Apply the migration:

**Option 1: Using Supabase CLI (if running locally)**
```bash
supabase db reset
# or if you want to apply just this migration:
supabase migration up
```

**Option 2: Apply the SQL directly**
Run the SQL from `supabase/migrations/20260130000002_custom_claims_hook.sql` in your Supabase SQL editor.

**What I fixed:**
1. Added error handling — wraps queries in try-catch blocks
2. Handles missing user profiles — works even if the profile doesn't exist yet
3. Handles NULL values — checks for null/empty work_email before querying
4. More robust user_id extraction — handles extraction failures gracefully

The hook should now work even when:
- The user profile hasn't been created yet (timing issue with trigger)
- The user doesn't have a verified work email yet
- There are NULL values in the database

After applying the migration, try logging in again. The hook should no longer fail.

Updated the configuration. `allowedDevOrigins` expects origin strings (protocol + host + optional port), not URLs with paths or wildcards.

**What changed:**
- Removed `/*` wildcards (not needed for origins)
- Added multiple origin variations to cover different cases
- Included origins with and without ports

```bash
# Stop the current server (Ctrl+C) and restart
pnpm dev
```

The warning should disappear after restarting. If it persists, check which origin is making the request (it may be a different port or protocol) and add it to the `allowedDevOrigins` array.
